blocks.tamil_translation: Rasulullah ﷺ. After he said this, wherever Rasulullah ﷺ halted, the Sahabah too would camp together. They would camp together to such an extent that it would be said (on seeing how close they were to one another) that if a sheet were spread over all of them, that sheet would cover them all.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ صَخْرِ نِ الْغَامِدِيِّ ﵁ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ: اَللّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لِأُمَّتِي فِي بُكُورِهَا وَكَانَ إِذَا بَعَثَ سَرِيَّةً أَوْ جَيْشاً بَعَثَهَا مِنْ أَوَّلِ النَّهَارِ، وَكَانَ صَخْرٌ رَجُلاً تَاجِرًا، وَكَانَ يَبْعَثُ تِجَارَتَهُ مِنْ أَوَّلِ النَّهَارِ، فَأَثْرَي وَكَثُرَ مَالُهُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابو داؤد، باب في الابتكار في السفر، رقم:٢٦٠٦
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Sakhr Ghamidi (RA) narrates, (اَللّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لِأُمَّتِي فِي بُكُورِهَا) “O Allah, bless my Ummah in its early mornings!” Rasulullah ﷺ made this du'a. And whenever he sent out a small detachment or a large army, he would send them out in the morning. Hazrat Sakhr (RA) was a trader; he would send his trade goods out for sale in the morning through his workers. Because of that he became wealthy (his wealth increased greatly).

blocks.text: Explanation:- Let my Ummah travel in the early morning; whatever work they do at that time, worldly or religious, they will receive barakah in it” — this is the purpose of the du'a that Rasulullah ﷺ made in this hadith.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ﵁ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ لِأَكْثَمَ بْنِ الْجَوْنِ الْخُزَاعِيِّ: يَا أَكْثَمُ! اُغْزُ مَعَ غَيْرِ قَوْمِكَ يَحْسُنْ خُلُقُكَ، وَتَكْرُمْ
